facts.text: Indonesia is an archipelago between the Indian and Pacific oceans.
Its islands lie on both sides of the Equator.
Indonesian, or Bahasa Indonesia, is the official language.

culture.text: Wayang kulit uses shadow puppets, often accompanied by a gamelan orchestra.

food.name: Nasi goreng
food.text: Indonesian fried rice is found across the archipelago, with many variations.
